name: g_cutsceneSceneVtable
comment: Vtable of the Cutscene_Scene class: slot 0 creates the actor models, slots 1-5 are the scene's layout/script helpers and slot 6 is Cutscene_FindResourceEntry. Cutscene_Scene_Init stamps it into every new scene object and Cutscene_Scene_Dtor re-installs it before teardown.
evidence: structs.json: class Cutscene_Scene, vtable 0x00766E7C, 7 slots (0 Cutscene_CreateActorModels, 6 Cutscene_FindResourceEntry); the retail words at 0x00766E7C are exactly those code pointers; literals 0x003985F8 (Cutscene_Scene_Init) and 0x0039867C (Cutscene_Scene_Dtor) both resolve to this table.

name: maybe_g_cutsceneToggleFlag
comment: One-byte latch toggled between 0 and 1 by Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline while action bit 0x1000 is set in the input snapshot and the scene is in its alternate input mode. No other code reads or writes it, so it is a private per-scene toggle whose visible effect cannot be proven from this function.
evidence: only user is Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline (literal 0x003984B4): *g_003984b4 = *g_003984b4 == 0 inside the self+0x16 && input word & 0x1000 branch; .data byte, retail value 0; no other literal points at 0x007A2CFC.

name: g_cutSceneActorClassRecord
comment: Named class record for the 'CutSceneActor' actor type: three intrusive list words (+0x0..+0x8), a parent-class pointer (+0xC = 0x007C33D4) and a pointer to the ASCII name 'CutSceneActor' (+0x10). Field_RegisterCutSceneActorClasses creates it at startup and Cutscene_CreateActorModels / maybe_Event_Packet_AttachModel compare object class ids against it.
evidence: 0x002A55EC called with r0=0x007C34C0, r1=0x007C33D4 (parent), r2='CutSceneActor' @0x0068C364; it stores parent at +0xC and name at +0x10; literal 0x0068C378 in Field_RegisterCutSceneActorClasses; class id compared in Cutscene_CreateActorModels (0x00397F84) and maybe_Event_Packet_AttachModel (0x003D207C); the next record starts at +0x14.

name: g_cutScenePlayerActorClassRecord
comment: Named class record for the 'CutScenePlayerActor' type, the player-controlled actor in a cutscene: parent pointer +0xC = 0x007C34C0 (CutSceneActor) and name pointer +0x10 = 'CutScenePlayerActor'. Field_RegisterCutSceneActorClasses creates it and Cutscene_CreateActorModels compares attachment class ids against it.
evidence: record at 0x007C34C0+0x14; same 0x002A55EC registration with parent 0x007C34C0 and string 'CutScenePlayerActor' @0x0068C384 (stored at +0x10); compared as the attachment class id in Cutscene_CreateActorModels (literal 0x00397E40); the next record (ScriptGadgetActor) starts at +0x14.

name: maybe_g_listPanelClassRecord
comment: Static class record for the four-row list-panel window class (vtable 0x00762FEC): +0xC parent descriptor 0x007E2000, +0x10 factory 0x0016274C (allocates the 0x60-byte object) and +0x14 an 'is instance' predicate 0x00315EBC. Built lazily by 0x0068B23C; Cutscene_ResolveActorResource compares an object's class id against it while resolving the scene's panel from the resource list.
evidence: 0x0068B23C self-links the three list words, appends the record to *0x007BE380 and writes 0x007E2000 / 0x0016274C / 0x00315EBC at +0xC/+0x10/+0x14; factory 0x0016274C allocates 0x60 bytes and stamps vtable 0x00762FEC (slot 10 Ui_DiveForm_ListPanel_InitPanes, layouts txt_list4_2/3/5/6); literal 0x003970F0 in Cutscene_ResolveActorResource tests class identity.
